clause: History-driven paint tools: history/snapshot brush + art-history brush [STU-RAS-024]

scope.summary: Implement the history-driven painting tools over the brush engine and the per-file history stack (MT-011): History/snapshot brush (paints pixels from a chosen history state or snapshot back into the image — selective brushed re-state) and Art-history brush (paints stylized strokes derived from a history state with style, fidelity, and area controls). Requires the StudioHistoryEntry states as a paint source.
acceptance_criteria: history/snapshot brush paints from a chosen history state
art-history brush applies stylized strokes with style/fidelity/area controls
expected_tests: live: make edits, take a snapshot, then history-brush a region back to the snapshot state and confirm selective revert via snapshot
live: art-history brush applies stylized strokes from a chosen history state with style/fidelity controls
test: paint source resolves to a StudioHistoryEntry state

risk_if_missed: No selective history painting; snapshot-based retouch workflow absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
